title: AI Gender Bias, Disparities, and Fairness: Does Training Data Matter?
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its findings are focused on gender bias, concluding that training models on gender-balanced (mixed) datasets reduces gender disparities and improves fairness in automatic scoring compared to models trained on gender-specific datasets.
